title: Bethel v. Southeast Alabama Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC ruled the complaint administratively out of order on two independent grounds: untimely filing (BCO 43-2; OMSJC 18.10.b) and lack of standing because complainant was a Deacon who was not a Presbytery commissioner when the challenged action was taken (BCO 43-1). No merits determination appears.
first_summary: The SJC dismissed Complaint 2012-06 as administratively out of order because the complaint was untimely and the complainant lacked standing. No merits decision appears.
summary: The SJC held Complaint 2012-06 administratively out of order because it was not filed within thirty days (BCO 43-2; OMSJC 18.10.b) and because the complainant, a Deacon who was not a commissioner to Presbytery at the time of the challenged action, lacked standing (BCO 43-1). No merits review appears; the adopted vote was 18 concurring, 2 not qualified, and 4 absent.
